abstractEnglish: We prove that deciding whether Weisfeiler–Leman refinement of an input dimension identifies a given graph is EXPTIME-complete. The input is a nonempty finite simple uncolored graph in adjacency-matrix form and a positive binary-encoded dimension. Identification quantifies over every comparison graph.
titleEn: The complexity of identifying a graph by Weisfeiler–Leman refinement
titleZh: 用Weisfeiler–Leman精化识别图的复杂性

details.overview: 该稿件研究Weisfeiler–Leman精化识别图问题的计算复杂性。作者声称：判定给定维数的Weisfeiler–Leman精化是否识别输入图是EXPTIME完全的。摘要说明输入为非空有限简单无权图（邻接矩阵形式）与正二进制编码维数，识别量化对所有比较图进行。该结果刻画了图识别问题的复杂度上界与下界，属于组合数学与图论中的算法复杂性研究。
keyPoints: 声称判定WL精化是否识别给定图是EXPTIME完全的
输入为邻接矩阵图与二进制编码维数
识别定义量化对所有比较图
